name: Invert Binary Tree
description:
Given the root of a binary tree, invert the tree (create its mirror image), and return its root.

Every node's left child becomes its right child and vice versa.

complexity.space: O(H) where H is the height of the tree

hints: Base case: if root == nil, return nil.
Swap the left and right children of root: `root.Left, root.Right = root.Right, root.Left`.
Recursively call InvertTree on both children, and return root.
